description: List top-level entries in a discussion topic, page by page. Read-only. Entry text is fenced as untrusted. Prefer get_full_topic_view to read a whole thread at once.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (one page of results). Smaller is faster.

page.description: Which page of results to show, starting at 1. Use it when a result says there are more.

topic_id.description: Discussion topic ID (numeric string). Get it from list_topics.

name: list_entries
title: List Entries
